notes: The Standing tab and the level-admission gate behind it are gone. Every field on that page was a constant: five models, five identical status chips, five identical sentences, and a held-out column reading not run five times. Nothing on it varied by security or by model, so it discriminated between nothing. The gate that was supposed to fill it timed out at 180s on its first real run — it called sectorFacts.gather() inside a per-member loop, so a sector cohort meant hundreds of sequential provider calls. It was written and tested against synthetic columns without its runtime ever being consider
